libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: jts-core is a pure-Java, self-contained geometry library (the historical source JTS was ported *into* C++ GEOS, not the reverse) with no runtime dependencies, no native/JNI component, no database or Docker service, and no required env vars or system properties. The standard generated test scaffold (JUnit + testImplementation on jts-core) is sufficient to exercise its public API (GeometryFactory, PrecisionModel, spatial predicates/operations, WKT/WKB I/O).
